activities.prompt: In exactly two sentences, explain what an internet packet is. Answer in English.

Write an original 650-to-750-word explanatory article in English about how a web browser loads a web page. Cover DNS lookup, connection setup, HTTPS, requests, responses, and rendering. Use coherent paragraphs and no bullet points.
Generate a clean flat illustration on a plain white background: one red circle on the left and one blue square on the right. Do not include any text, logos, or extra objects.
Look at the attached image. Identify the shapes, their colors, and their relative positions. Answer in two English sentences.
